description: Two-layer LMFDB schema index. Layer 1: domain groups with one-line summaries. Layer 2: per-group table listings with key queryable columns. The SQL generator loads full column detail from lmfdb_schema.json for the specific tables selected.

classical_modular_forms.description: Classical holomorphic modular forms on GL(2)/Q, including newforms, newspaces, Hecke data, twists, and auxiliary spaces.

tables.mf_newforms: Galois orbits of newforms; key cols: label, level, weight, char_orbit_label (character / nebentypus orbit; NOT char_label), char_order, dim, analytic_rank, is_cm (complex multiplication), is_rm, fricke_eigenval (Atkin-Lehner / Fricke eigenvalue), traces, level_is_squarefree, level_is_prime, level_is_square, level_radical, sato_tate_group, projective_image, artin_degree, minimal_twist
tables.mf_newspaces: Newspaces S_k^new(N,chi); key cols: label, level, weight, char_orbit_label (character / nebentypus orbit; NOT char_label), char_order, dim, num_forms, sturm_bound, mf_dim, cusp_dim, eis_dim, plus_dim, dihedral_dim, hecke_orbit_dims, level_is_squarefree, level_is_prime
tables.mf_hecke_cc: Hecke eigenvalues at complex embeddings; key cols: label, level, weight, hecke_orbit, embedding_m, embedding_index, conrey_index, an_normalized, angles
tables.mf_hecke_nf: Hecke eigenvalues over the coefficient number field; key cols: label, level, weight, hecke_orbit_code, an (jsonb), ap (jsonb), field_poly, maxp
tables.mf_hecke_traces: Hecke trace data by index; key cols: hecke_orbit_code, n, trace_an
tables.mf_hecke_charpolys: Characteristic polynomials of T_p; key cols: hecke_orbit_code, p, charpoly_factorization
tables.mf_hecke_lpolys: Local L-polynomials; key cols: hecke_orbit_code, p, lpoly, lpoly_factorization
tables.mf_twists_cc: Twists at complex embeddings; key cols: source_label, target_label, twisting_char_label, source_level, target_level, conductor, order, degree
tables.mf_twists_nf: Twists over coefficient field; key cols: source_label, target_label, twisting_char_label, source_level, target_level, conductor, order, degree, self_twist_disc
tables.mf_boxes: Completeness boxes; key cols: Nmin, Nmax, kmin, kmax, newform_count, eigenvalues, embeddings
tables.mf_gamma1: Spaces for Gamma_1(N); key cols: label, level, weight, dim, num_forms, mf_dim, cusp_dim, dihedral_dim, level_is_squarefree
tables.mf_stark: Stark units for weight-1 forms; key cols: mf_label, mf_level, mf_dim, stark_minpoly

maass_forms.description: Maass newforms on GL(2), including numerical and rigorously certified forms with their Fourier coefficients.

tables.maass_newforms: Numerical Maass forms; key cols: maass_id, level, weight, conrey_index, spectral_parameter, symmetry, fricke_eigenvalue, error
tables.maass_newforms_coefficients: Coefficients of numerical Maass forms; key cols: maass_id, coefficients
tables.maass_rigor: Rigorously certified Maass forms; key cols: maass_label, maass_index, level, weight, conrey_index, spectral_parameter, spectral_error, symmetry, fricke_eigenvalue
tables.maass_rigor_coefficients: Coefficients of certified Maass forms; key cols: maass_label, coefficients, coefficient_errors

hilbert_bianchi_siegel.description: Hilbert modular forms over totally real fields, Bianchi modular forms over imaginary quadratic fields, and Siegel modular forms of genus 2.

tables.hmf_forms: Hilbert modular forms; key cols: label, field_label, level_norm, disc, weight, is_CM, is_base_change, hecke_polynomial
tables.hmf_fields: Base fields for HMFs; key cols: label, degree, disc, narrow_class_number, used_grh
tables.hmf_hecke: HMF Hecke eigenvalues; key cols: label, hecke_polynomial, hecke_eigenvalues
tables.bmf_forms: Bianchi modular forms; key cols: label, field_label, level_norm, level_ideal, weight, dimension, is_base_change, is_CM
tables.bmf_dims: Bianchi space dimensions; key cols: field_label, level_norm, weight, dimension
tables.smf_samples: Siegel modular form samples; key cols: label, weight, degree, level, field, representation
tables.smf_dims: Siegel space dimensions; key cols: family, weight, degree, level, dim
tables.smf_families: Siegel form families; key cols: name, plain_name, degree, order
tables.smf_ev: Siegel eigenvalues; key cols: owner_id, index, data
tables.smf_fc: Siegel Fourier coefficients; key cols: owner_id, det, data

other_modular_forms.description: Half-integral weight forms, mod-l modular forms, and mod-l Galois representations.

tables.halfmf_forms: Half-integral weight forms; key cols: label, level, weight, dim, character
tables.modlmf_forms: Mod-l modular forms; key cols: label, base_label, level, characteristic, weight_grading, ordinary, deg
tables.modlgal_reps: Mod-l Galois representations; key cols: label, dimension, algebraic_group, base_ring_characteristic, conductor, image_label, image_type, is_irreducible, is_surjective, is_solvable, weight, traces

l_functions.description: L-functions and their instances. Use lfunc_search for filtered searches; use lfunc_lfunctions for full data; use lfunc_instances to join L-functions to source objects.

tables.lfunc_lfunctions: Full L-function data; key cols: label, Lhash, degree, conductor, motivic_weight, root_number (text; sign of the functional equation), symmetry_type, order_of_vanishing (analytic rank), primitive, self_dual, algebraic, st_group, positive_zeros, z1 (first / lowest zero), z2, z3, dirichlet_coefficients, a2-a10, A2-A10, gamma_factors, bad_lfactors
tables.lfunc_search: Search-optimised L-function view; key cols: label, degree, conductor, motivic_weight, order_of_vanishing (analytic rank), primitive, self_dual, algebraic, rational, symmetry_type, z1 (first / lowest zero), root_angle, instance_types, instance_urls, is_instance_CMF, is_instance_ECQ, is_instance_Artin, euler2 through euler97
tables.lfunc_instances: Object-to-L-function links; key cols: label, Lhash, type (CMF/EC/G2C/NF/DIR/Artin), url — use for joins between source objects and lfunc_lfunctions

elliptic_curves.description: Elliptic curves over Q and number fields. Core search invariants — rank, conductor, Weierstrass coefficients (a-invariants), j-invariant, torsion, CM, discriminant — all live in ec_curvedata. Also covers Mordell-Weil generators and BSD invariants, local reduction data, Galois representations, and p-adic data.

tables.ec_curvedata: Elliptic curves over Q; PRIMARY KEY is lmfdb_label (e.g. 11.a1); key cols: lmfdb_label, Clabel (Cremona label), conductor, ainvs (Weierstrass coefficients / a-invariants [a1,a2,a3,a4,a6]), rank, analytic_rank, torsion (NOT torsion_order), torsion_structure, cm, bad_primes, jinv (j-invariant), isogeny_degrees, sha, regulator, squarefree_disc, semistable, szpiro_ratio, abc_quality, modell_images, nonmax_primes, faltings_height, degree, manin_constant, num_int_pts (number of integral points)
tables.ec_classdata: Isogeny classes; key cols: label, conductor, rank, class_size, class_deg
tables.ec_mwbsd: Mordell-Weil and BSD data; key cols: lmfdb_label, gens, heights, ngens, real_period (numeric), sha_an (numeric), special_value (numeric), tamagawa_product — NOTE: real_period/sha_an/special_value are plain numeric
tables.ec_localdata: Local reduction at bad primes; key cols: lmfdb_label, prime, reduction_type, root_number, kodaira_symbol, tamagawa_number, conductor_valuation, discriminant_valuation
tables.ec_galrep: Galois representations; key cols: lmfdb_label, prime, image, surjective
tables.ec_padic: p-adic L-functions; key cols: lmfdb_label, p, lambda, mu
tables.ec_iwasawa: Iwasawa invariants; key cols: lmfdb_label, lambda, mu
tables.ec_torsion_growth: Torsion growth over extensions; key cols: lmfdb_label, field_label, torsion_structure
tables.ec_nfcurves: Elliptic curves over number fields; key cols: label, field_label, conductor_norm, conductor_ideal, rank, torsion_order, base_change, cm, ainvs

genus2_curves.description: Genus-2 curves over Q and their Jacobians, including endomorphism algebras, Galois representations, rational points, and local data.

tables.g2c_curves: Genus-2 curves; key cols: label, cond (CONDUCTOR IS 'cond' NOT 'conductor'), abs_disc, analytic_rank, mw_rank, torsion_order, end_alg, geom_end_alg, st_group, is_gl2_type, is_simple_base, is_simple_geom, root_number, bad_primes, regulator, num_rat_pts, two_selmer_rank, has_square_sha
tables.g2c_endomorphisms: Endomorphism algebras; key cols: label, end_ring, geometric_end_ring, st_label
tables.g2c_galrep: Galois representations; key cols: label, prime, image
tables.g2c_ratpts: Rational points; key cols: label, known_pts, has_square_sha, locally_solvable
tables.g2c_tamagawa: Local data; key cols: label, prime, tamagawa_number, reduction_type

abelian_varieties.description: Isogeny classes of abelian varieties over finite fields, with endomorphism algebra data.

tables.av_fq_isog: Abelian variety isogeny classes over F_q; key cols: label, g (genus), p (characteristic), q (field size), poly (Weil polynomial; poly_str is the string form), slopes (Newton slopes), p_rank, angle_rank, is_simple, is_geometrically_simple, is_supersingular, has_jacobian, has_principal_polarization, jacobian_count, principal_polarization_count, is_squarefree, splitting_field
tables.av_fq_endalg_data: Endomorphism algebra data; key cols: label, center, galois_group, places, brauer_invariants
tables.av_fq_endalg_factors: Endomorphism algebra factors; key cols: base_label, extension_label, extension_degree, multiplicity

number_fields.description: Number fields over Q, with Galois groups, class groups, regulators, and auxiliary data including reflex fields and extra invariants.

tables.nf_fields: Number fields; key cols: label, degree, r2 (number of complex places; signature is [degree-2*r2, r2]), disc_abs, disc_sign, disc_rad, class_number, narrow_class_number, regulator, galois_label (Galois group, e.g. 4T3), galt, is_galois, gal_is_abelian, gal_is_cyclic, gal_is_solvable, cm, ramps, num_ram, conductor, monogenic, coeffs (defining polynomial coefficients), used_grh
tables.nf_fields_extra: Extra number field data; key cols: label, units, zk (integral basis), frobs, dirichlet_group
tables.nf_fields_reflex: Reflex fields of CM fields; key cols: nf_label, rf_coeffs, multiplicity, CM_types, galois_orbits

local_fields.description: p-adic local fields and finite fields.

tables.lf_fields: p-adic local fields; key cols: label, p, n (degree), e (ramification index), f (residue degree), c (discriminant exponent), galois_label, gal, slopes, top_slope, is_completion, inertia, coeffs
tables.lf_families: p-adic field families; key cols: label, p, n, e, f, family, packet_size
tables.fq_fields: Finite fields; key cols: label, characteristic, degree, polynomial

artin_representations.description: Artin representations rho: Gal(Kbar/Q) -> GL_n(C), with associated splitting field data.

tables.artin_reps: Artin representations; key cols: Baselabel, Dim (dimension), Conductor (numeric), GaloisLabel, Galn, Galt, Indicator (Frobenius-Schur: 1=orthogonal, -1=symplectic, 0=unitary), Is_Even, BadPrimes, NumBadPrimes, CharacterField, GaloisConjugates — NOTE: column names are CamelCase
tables.artin_field_data: Splitting field data; key cols: Polynomial, TransitiveDegree, Size, ConjClasses, ArtinReps, FrobResolvents, ComplexConjugation — NOTE: column names are CamelCase

tables.char_dirichlet: Dirichlet characters; key cols: label, modulus, conductor, orbit, primitive_orbit, order (RESERVED SQL KEYWORD: always quote as "order"), degree, is_primitive, is_real, is_even, is_minimal — NOTE: 'order' must always be quoted in SQL

hypergeometric_motives.description: Hypergeometric motive families H(alpha,beta) and their specialisations.

tables.hgm_families: HGM families; key cols: label, degree, weight, hodge_vector, gal_label, is_primitive, conductor_label, wild_primes
tables.hgm_motives: HGM specialisations H(A,B) at parameter t; key cols: label, A (alpha parameters), B (beta parameters), t (specialisation value), cond (conductor; column is 'cond' NOT 'conductor'), degree, weight (motivic weight), sign (sign of functional equation), hodge (Hodge vector), famhodge (family Hodge vector), centralval (central L-value)
tables.hgm_monodromy: HGM monodromy groups; key cols: label, family, monodromy_group, zariski_closure
tables.hgm_euler_survey: HGM Euler factors; key cols: family, p, t, euler_factor

belyi_maps.description: Belyi maps (dessins d'enfants), their passports, and specialisations.

tables.belyi_galmaps: Belyi maps; key cols: label, deg (degree), group, abc, pass_label, num_models, is_primitive, field_of_definition
tables.belyi_passports: Belyi passports; key cols: pass_label, deg, group, abc, num_orbits, num_maps
tables.belyi_specializations: Belyi specialisations; key cols: label, t, field

modular_curves.description: Modular curves X(H) for subgroups H of GL_2(Z_hat), their models, points, and maps.

tables.modcurve_models: Modular curve models; key cols: label, genus, cusps, rational_cusps, num_rat_pts, pointless, has_non_sing_model
tables.modcurve_points: Points on modular curves; key cols: curve_label, degree, residue_field, coordinates, j_field, jinv, isolated
tables.modcurve_modelmaps: Maps between modular curve models; key cols: domain_label, codomain_label, degree, coordinates

groups.description: Abstract finite groups, their subgroups, conjugacy classes, characters, and Sato-Tate groups.

tables.gps_groups: Abstract finite groups; key cols: label, order, exponent, derived_length, abelian, cyclic, solvable, simple, perfect, nilpotent, almost_simple, quasisimple, number_subgroups, number_conjugacy_classes
tables.gps_subgroup_data: Subgroup data; key cols: label, ambient, subgroup, quotient, index, normal, characteristic, cyclic, abelian, solvable, perfect, maximal, central
tables.gps_conj_classes: Conjugacy classes; key cols: label, group, size, order, centralizer
tables.gps_transitive: Transitive groups (Galois groups); key cols: label, n (degree), t, order, parity, abelian, solvable, primitive, auts, arith_equiv
tables.gps_st: Sato-Tate groups; key cols: label, weight, degree, rational, identity_component, component_group, components, trace_moments
tables.gps_gl2zhat: Subgroups of GL_2(Z_hat); key cols: label, level, index, genus, contains_negative_one, det_index, scalar_label
tables.gps_char: Complex characters; key cols: label, group, degree, indicator, kernel, faithful
tables.gps_qchar: Rational characters; key cols: label, group, degree, indicator, schur_index
tables.gps_small: Small groups (order <= 2000); key cols: label, gap_id, order, abelian, cyclic, solvable
tables.gps_families: Group families; key cols: label, name, order_formula
tables.gps_special_names: Special group names; key cols: label, name, tex_name

tables.hecke_algebras: Hecke algebras; key cols: label, level, weight, index, structure
tables.hecke_orbits: Hecke algebra orbits; key cols: label, hecke_label, charpoly, dim
tables.hecke_ladic: l-adic Hecke algebras; key cols: label, hecke_label, prime, structure, gorenstein_defect

tables.hgcwa_passports: HGC automorphism passports; key cols: label, genus, group, signature, refined_passport_label, num_orbits
tables.hgcwa_unique_groups: Unique automorphism groups; key cols: label, genus, group, order, signature

lattices_and_other.description: Integral lattices and cluster pictures for hyperelliptic curves.

tables.lat_lattices: Integral lattices; key cols: label, dim, det, minimum, kissing_number, aut_order, gram
tables.cluster_pictures: Cluster pictures at bad primes; key cols: label, prime, picture, num_clusters, depth
